dataset: Lantmäteriet Markhöjdmodell Nedladdning, grid 1+ (source tile metadata identifies 1 m cells; exact service product label should be reconciled with acquisition receipt)
dataset_identity: Lantmäteriet height-model grid tiles m657_66 through m658_68; exact product catalogue title is not stated in supplied tile sidecars and remains to be confirmed.
fixture_sampling: 10 m local-grid cell spacing, bilinear resampling from source 1 m grids; grid includes a 20 m buffer around requested geographic bounds.

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
license.requirements: Attribute product name and © Lantmäteriet, identify modifications, link CC BY 4.0.

modifications: Clipped to expanded Stockholm bounds plus 20 m; bilinearly resampled from 1 m to 10 m in the project local equirectangular frame and compressed as NPZ.
provenance_note: Acquisition dates/methods and stated height accuracy are tile-specific polygons in upstream *_ursprung.json and were not reduced to a single scene date. Elevations are absolute RH2000 heights and are not game water-relative values.
resampling: Rasterio/GDAL bilinear warp from 1 m source to 10 m local equirectangular grid; source values retained in RH2000 metres
source_vertical_reference: RH2000 height, gravity-related metres upward (source compound CRS EPSG:5845)
vertical_crs: RH2000 (EPSG: [vertical component encoded in source compound EPSG:5845])
vertical_datum_note: Values remain absolute RH2000 elevations; no subtraction of sea level/game water and no game-physics interpretation.
